sourceMathEvidence: The prompt says a 240 m rope makes two adjacent rectangular regions, one of them square, and asks for the square side when the sum of both areas is maximized. The bitmap shows one outer rectangle with one interior vertical divider.
solutionMathEvidence: The solution lets x be the square side and y the full width, counts three vertical spans and two horizontal spans to get 3x+2y=240, then models total area as xy. It completes S(x)=120x−(3/2)x²=−(3/2)(x−40)²+2400, giving x=40 m.
